}}'''Meditation''' is a tier two [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Temples|Mountain Temple]] and the Pacifist task, which grants the [[Altar of Peace]] if no attacks are made for five consecutive turns.  

The [[Ai-Mo]] [[Tribes|tribe]] starts with Meditation.

== History ==
In [[Update History|update 2.0.58]], the [[Defence Bonus|defence bonus]] in mountain tiles was moved from Meditation to [[Climbing]].
